intro: At the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Sergeant Yohwa seeks to blunt Colonel Kurzen's military advantage by targeting his medical support. The renegades rely on powerful remedies and toxins concocted by their practitioners, leaving the resistance fighters desperate to turn those same concoctions to their own advantage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized. He has gathered around him a large number of Medicine Men who heal his forces with Jungle Remedies and poison our fighters with Venom Fern Extracts.

We need those remedies to cure our own people, and we need a sample of those extracts to study so we can make our own remedies. Search the Kurzen Compound for both - his Medicine Men will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm waiting on those remedies and that extract, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape. And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.
